ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across >95% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to the distal tips and sparse focal points, creating a very low global white-to-black ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a continuous dark mass. High-contrast white geometric clusters are mapped exclusively to the extreme distal tips. Small, isolated white focal spots are visible on the interior of the right lobe trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 45-55 degrees; the notch depth is approximately 1/6th of the vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge of both lobes; characterized by multiple jagged peaks and valleys with a prominent indentation at the mid-point of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit an upward-curving sweep from the peduncle, with the trailing edges showing a slight concavity moving toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-contrast, rough-textured white pixels on the extreme outer tips of both lobes, consistent with calcified growth patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single vertical, high-intensity linear mark on the inner-right lobe; several smaller, faint horizontal disruptions on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular texture and white pigmentation at the distal tips; small semi-circular notch missing from the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately 20% from the tip.
